sentences.text: The May 2014 RBI circular that said banks would not be permitted to charge foreclosure charges or pre-payment penalties on all floating rate term loans sanctioned to individual borrowers is no longer in force on 2026-11-23, because it was repealed and withdrawn. [E6, E2, R6]
So, that 2014 circular cannot be quoted as the current rule today. [E6, E2, R6]

For this Tier 3 UCB, the in-force rule that applies is the residual clause that, in cases other than those covered by the specific paragraphs, pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB. [R11]
I did not find an in-force RBI rule in the provided materials that keeps the May 2014 prohibition in force today for this bank and case. [E2, R6, R11]

missing.searched: searched the provided RBI materials for an in-force version of the May 2014 foreclosure-charge prohibition applicable today; found only the repealed 2014 circular and the UCB residual clause.
